critical_code_review_comments: Per-variant image uploads currently stay as base64 data-URLs in Mongo (variant 0 image saved at len≈743, prefix data:image/png;base64). Code comment in /app/backend/routers/maker.py only uploads payload.images to R2 (loop at L207-223), not variant.image. As DB rows grow with multiple variants × multiple makers, this will inflate Mongo and make GET /api/products/{slug} payloads heavy. Add a parallel R2 upload pass for any variant.image data URL using key_prefix=f'products/{slug}/variants'. The sweeper (scripts/sweep_r2_orphans.py) collect_referenced_keys would also need to pull variant.image keys, otherwise newly-uploaded variant images would be flagged as orphans. (Main agent's note acknowledged this is intentional for now.)

_decrement_stock_and_collect_low (routers/checkout.py L19-67) does an extra full-doc fetch (find_one with no projection) per line item just to read the post-decrement variant in_stock. Use the modifier_count + an aggregation projection or do an `update_one` followed by a single projected `find_one({slug}, {variants:1, in_stock:1})`. Minor perf nit only.

MakerDashboard.jsx is now ~1458 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline (re-flagged from iter11). NewListingModal alone is ~400 lines and hosts axis1/axis2 + per-variant image upload + .glb upload. Split into /pages/maker/components/{NewListingModal,ProductEditCard,VariantsEditor}.jsx — confirmed deferred per problem statement.

ProductDetail 2D-grid render condition: confirms grid only when ALL variants have BOTH axis1+axis2 AND both axis names set (L141-220). Good. Suggest a small visual hint on MakerDashboard when only some variants have axis2 filled, so makers don't silently fall back to flat list.
